page.layout: One page of text: a centred title block at the top, then one column of verse, with the signature and catchword at the foot on the right.

main_text.head: EPIGRAMMATA.
IN EMBLEMA BILIBALDI PIRCKEIMERI, Cæsarei quondam Consiliarii, & Senatoris Reipub. Norimb.

p.i: MIRAE quid hoc rei? Ecquid Acheronte nata proles, Plutíque neptis ATE, Cor forpice hac tenaci Vorsans terit per igneis, Triplicíque malleo instans THLIPSIS laboriosè Tundit, retundit ictus Geminans, nihilque cessans, Adeò ut fatiscat incus; Sperántne rumpere hoc cor? Cujus rei hæc figura est?
SPECVLO videmus istoc, Quid sufferant malorum, Quantum ferant laborum. (Hic occupante & illic Tyrannidem maligno Livore) quotquot usquam Agunt Boni, & per orbem

page.notes: The first letter M of the opening word is a large initial, joined to "IRAE" in small capitals. The catchword "Rari" is in a decorative hand and is only moderately certain. The verse lines are joined within each stanza, which follows the stanza rule; the line breaks are not kept. The printed "forpice" carries a connecting stroke after "c" that is read as "ce". No page number or running head is printed.
